feedforward: inverse-dynamics joint torque, contact-consistent (a walk: look.look_inverse_dynamics, F5's rolling contact); MJCF joint damping and friction not included

rules.S2S-sets: three reference sets per body, each a directory stage2/sets/<set>/<body>/ in Stage 1's run-directory layout: V0 (control: today's walk), F25F9 (control: the pull request's _tuned_f9_spec, verbatim) and F25F9cl (candidate: that spec with duty 0.59 and lift 0.095 H at every speed) (STAGE2_75_PLAN.md A1)
rules.S2S-speeds: walks nominal (sizing.NOMINAL's Froude number) and v0.3, v0.35, v0.4, v0.45, v0.5 (A2).  V0: sizing.NOMINAL at the nominal speed; look.speed_spec between sizing.NOMINAL and sizing.BRISK below BRISK's speed and between sizing.BRISK and envelope.FAST from there to FAST's speed; above FAST's speed FAST's stride, duty and lift at the higher Froude number, labelled new.  F25F9cl: every rung other than 0.40, 0.45 and 0.50 m/s labelled new
rules.S2S-margin: duty and lift set after results on seeds 3042-3061 (JPS 2.3)
rules.S2S-crouch: every walk of a set and body has one crouch (a share of the hip height), read from its spec and recorded as set.json crouch_frac and in every walk entry; a move joins two walks of one crouch (one LIPM frequency)
rules.S2S-process: every array is made inside s2io.r2() (gait accuracy r2, checked on entry and on exit) with one BLAS thread, each item in a fresh process on a body rebuilt for it (look.source); a walk's inverse dynamics, summary and both array formats come from the one generation in the one block
rules.S2S-formats: a walk is written twice from one generation: refs/<name>.npz (Stage 1's reference format, which the bar plays and a freeze lists) and look/<name>.npz (the look ladder's format, which the Stage 0 screen and the clips read); the build stops unless q, qd and qdd of the two are equal
rules.S2S-twins: where Stage 1's run (stage1/runs/2026-11-08/<body>) holds a walk of the same spec, or a transition between walks of the same specs made with Stage 1's own schedule, the set's file must have its sha256; where the look ladder (stage2/look/look_refs.json) holds a rung of the same spec, the look-format file must have its sha256; a difference stops the build with both hashes (STAGE2_75_PLAN.md A4).  V0 owes them: on a body that has a Stage 1 run record its nominal and start must be Stage 1's own files, and on a body the look ladder holds its look-format nominal and v0.4 must be the ladder's rungs; a twin that is not found there stops the build and fails sets verify (SetDef.stage1_twins, ladder_twins)
rules.S2S-stage0: the Stage 0 gates that block a freeze (STAGE2_75_PLAN.md A12) are read where a reference is built, with the set screen's own functions: a walk by setscreen.judge_walk on its look.price, a move by setscreen.screen_move on its file; the set's screen.json is made afterwards by setscreen and must agree (sets verify)
rules.S2S-not-available: an item with no reference is an entry with available false, a reason and its numbers, and no file; it is listed in set.json not_available; a walk that fails a blocking Stage 0 gate is dropped from the ladder in this way and no move is built from or to it (STAGE2_75_PLAN.md A8, A11, A12).  No ramp, grid, gate or constant is changed for it.  Its verdict is the code's that built it (built_by): while the set is not frozen, a build by other Stage 2 modules makes it again; an array an earlier build left under its name is removed
rules.S2L-sets: the look sets: V6 (the look the owner picked at gate L1: every look feature in the walks) and V6noF5 (V6 with F5, the toe-off and the toes-up reach, off in the walks as well: the tracker fit's set), each a directory stage2/sets/<set>/<body>/ built, verified and frozen as every other set (STAGE2_TRACKB_PLAN.md L14).  A head body (<pick>-X) walks its pick's look on its own model
rules.S2L-chain: a V6 walk at a speed is look.ladder's chain on today's walk at that speed (the V0 set's, S2S-speeds): V1 = F1/F2 (bob = look.BOB_SHARE x that walk's enforced shortening, bob_skew, bob_drop, 12 correction passes), V2 = F3 (the animal pace's swing time), V3 = F4/F5, V4 = F6, V5 = F9/F10 with F9's tail phase, V6 = F14 with the fewest whole strides lasting 10 s; F13 (the longer stride of the 75 cm animal pace) is in no walk of a set.  At the nominal speed and at 0.40 m/s on the two picks that is the look ladder's V6 rung: its look-format file must hash to the ladder's (S2S-twins)
rules.S2L-tail-phase: F9's tail phase is the look ladder's own rule at every speed: look.tail_check on the walk's V4 (the phase that minimises the single-support stance pad's yaw moment).  At the nominal speed and at 0.40 m/s it is the ladder's recorded value (stage2/look/tail_phase.json), so that the walk is the ladder's rung; at the other rungs it is read from stage2/sets/V6/tail_phase.json, made by python -m designlab.stage2.sets tail-phase on the pick.  V6noF5 and a head body take the pick's V6 phases
rules.S2L-noF5: V6noF5 is V6 with F5's fields at their defaults in the walks: toe_off 0, toe_reach 0, no rate or acceleration cap, the default start and margin
rules.S2L-format: a look walk's file holds a window of K whole strides that is periodic as a whole: Stage 1's reference keys with 160 K frames and the window's stride motion, the feedforward from look.look_inverse_dynamics (F5's rolling split), then window_strides (K) and the look keys; its entry holds period_s (the stride's), window_s and strides (K).  A plan item counts windows of the file
rules.S2L-inplace: the turn in place at 0.5 rad/s, left and right (inplace_0.5_<dir>, with start_inplace_0.5_<dir> and stop_inplace_0.5_<dir>; STAGE2_TRACKB_PLAN.md L13), is the set's nominal look gait stepping in place (path speed 0) with flat feet as its own law (F5's fields at their defaults) and without F14 (one stride).  It is cut from one long plan of the same builder and laws: the start from the stand, then 4 hold strides more than Stage 1's start writes.  The reference is the second of those hold strides; it is gated for periodicity against the hold stride before it and the one after it (model CoM 1.0 mm, multibody ZMP 2.0 mm, joints 1e-3 rad, each mapped by the plan's own stride motion); no other plan length and no other stride is tried.  Its start is the same plan up to that stride; its stop is Stage 1's one-step stop from the reference.  Each of the three files is screened at Stage 0 as a move (setscreen.screen_move).  A gait that fails is recorded not available with its numbers, and its start and stop with it.  The three references of a direction are one optional group: a build makes them when they are named (--only), because the set's screen (setscreen) reads every entry of refs.json as a walk with a look-format file and cannot yet read a periodic turn
